correlated_prior_assessment: Partly shared priors. Ops Jaccard is 1.0 on both bundles, and on RESERVE it rose from 0.821 to 1.0 although section G has no rule about operations, so r3 cannot explain it. Contestable choices come out identical (R-73/R-92 ADOPT-DECISION, R-75 ANNOTATE rather than CONTRA), and both coders share unmandated readings (guards attached to operations; G2 over G1 on R-31). Their AMBIGUOUS choices do not overlap, so they are not copies. The design can establish within-family reproducibility and a narrow causal attribution (G1 removed the 17 vacuous-case splits; G7 created the V2 splits). It cannot establish reliability across coders in general, validity, or run-to-run noise (one run per coder). Same-family agreement is an upper bound; the non-Claude coder is the real test.
prereg_outcome: Row 3: 'V1 improves but another judgement drops by > 0.1' (V2 -0.143, V3 -0.107), i.e. a trade-off in which the G rules interact, and a review is needed. Row 1 does not apply. The sealed expectation was right on V1 and wrong that the other judgements would be stable.
derived_prediction_detail: V1 gain: Gate 1 +0.464 vs RESERVE 0.000. Mean over V1-V7: Gate 1 +0.071 vs RESERVE +0.011. Mean r3 levels: Gate 1 0.918 vs RESERVE 0.912. Only ops Jaccard gains more on RESERVE, and G does not target it. Caveats: the prediction named no metric, and RESERVE's V1 ceiling (0.923, so at most +0.077) meant it almost could not succeed on V1. The F1/F2/F4 mechanism gets partial support (R-40 V1, R-36 V1, R-49/R-92 V4), but RESERVE V4 fell despite having F4.

r4_recommendations.fix: Define 'mentions' as the four words in any word form (e.g. 'authorized', 'executed'); a concept in other words does not count.
V2 is UNTESTABLE unless at least two of the four terms are mentioned; the approval/acceptance exclusion removes only that pair.
A direct change attributed to an act listed under not_modelled is outside V3.

A competing reading counts only if it is consistent with the operations and not_modelled acts the coder listed and changes the code of this judgement; a reading that concerns another judgement does not count.
Apply G1 first; NOT-MODELLED only when at least one unmodelled act would be guarded by section C.
The bars attach to the content of an act (new vocabulary, categories, methodology), whatever its operation.
Import F4 (definition of evidence) and F1 (per-act UNTESTABLE when a guard's satisfaction is unstated) into the Gate 1 manual, or stop comparing gains across the two non-equivalent manuals.
